references.source_locator: Retained literature record; full-paper calibration reading

references.source_locator: Retained literature record; full-paper calibration reading

references.source_locator: Retained literature record; full-paper calibration reading

references.source_locator: Retained literature record; full-paper calibration reading

references.source_locator: Retained literature record; full-paper calibration reading

references.source_locator: Retained literature record; full-paper calibration reading

Tables/diagrams connect modest algorithmic choices to actual execution rather than theorem-only validation.

references.source_locator: Retained literature record; full-paper calibration reading
